items.q: players like Clark Terry and Freddy Webster ( ? ), and other ones that I don't know.

ctx.x: I mean, somebody coming up, born afterwards, being raised on his sound just automatically plays it and does it because it's there. But he had to create it. He had to create it against all ( ? and that he didn't like?). But he couldn't play and sound like anybody else, it didn't want to sound like anybody else because he couldn't, he couldn't be, I don't know, he couldn't be a musician and sound like anybody else. He didn't know that. That developed. And you go along, you try and you start out, you sound like so…
players like Clark Terry and Freddy Webster ( ? ), and other ones that I don't know. The early ones I'm Los Angeles and all that?). Harry James was an early one.

But eventually had run all those wave forms together and come out with his own original wave form because nobody else ever had that sound before. That's the first complete new sound on the trumpet that goes since Louis Armstrong.
